name: infiniFi USD
oneLiner: IUSD is infiniFi's USDC-collateralized dollar stablecoin, with reserves deployed duration-matched across institutional private credit and liquid DeFi lending.
collateral: USDC; deployed across institutional private credit strategies (Fasanara, Sentora, FalconX, Maple) and liquid DeFi markets (Spark, Fluid, Aave), duration-matched to user lock-up periods
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint/redeem against USDC with no fees; on-chain fractional reserve — liquid portion available for instant withdrawals, illiquid portion deployed to time-locked institutional lending strategies; redemptions queue when liquid reserves are insufficient

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: IUSD is tracked only on Ethereum in Pharos and reviewed infiniFi docs do not identify a material cross-chain route for the token. The metadata row is treated as single-chain/native.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: IUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: IUSD receipt token minting is gated by RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER role in the infiniFi Core (0xf6D48735EcCF12BDc1dF2674b1CE3FCb3Bd25490). Four protocol contracts hold the role: MintController, PLSmoother, MigrationController, and a TransparentUpgradeableProxy. The ultimate admin is a 7/4 Gnosis Safe (0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c) holding PROPOSER_ROLE and MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER in the Core.
